# Mass balance

`import metallurgypy.mass_balance`

Mass and metallurgical balances.

## `MassBalance`

```python
class MassBalance(feed_mass: Quantity | float, feed_grade: Quantity | float, recovery: Quantity | float, *, mode: CalculationMode | str = CalculationMode.STANDARD, tolerances: Tolerances = Tolerances(rel=1e-09, abs=1e-12)) -> None
```

Metal balance of one feed given its grade and the recovery to one product.

## `TwoProductBalance`

```python
class TwoProductBalance(feed_mass: Quantity | float, feed_grade: Quantity | float, concentrate_grade: Quantity | float, tailings_grade: Quantity | float, *, mode: CalculationMode | str = CalculationMode.STANDARD, tolerances: Tolerances = Tolerances(rel=1e-09, abs=1e-12)) -> None
```

Split of a feed into concentrate and tailings from the three measured grades.

With feed ``F``, grades ``g`` (feed), ``c`` (concentrate), ``t`` (tailings):

```text
C = F (g - t) / (c - t)      T = F (c - g) / (c - t)
mass yield = C / F           recovery = C c / (F g)
```
